analysis.reasonEn: RSI exited oversold but failed to reclaim 50+. MACD histogram shows improvement but remains negative. 5-day low support confirmed, but 20-day high breakout failed. Volume ratio of 0.84 is below average, lacking conviction. Current price $161.18 nears swing resistance at $161.45. Consider entry on confirmed 5-day low support and a break above the 20-day high. Currently in a wait-and-see phase.
